title: Low-overlap spatially concentrated matches destabilize pose
observed: OrthoLoC Figure 15: GIM+DKM + AdHoP shows sharp translation/rotation error increases below 20% covisibility.
evidence_type: external authors' empirical report; not reproduced here
inference_limits: Concentrated support is the authors' explanation, not a separately isolated causal result. Generic conditioning, support weighting, covariance inflation and rejecting low-overlap queries are established directions.

title: External elevation geometry degrades pose despite similar image matching error
observed: OrthoLoC Table 6: SP+LG matching error 2.5/2.5 px for DOP/DOP+DSM shift, while TE changes 0.42 to 1.07 m and 1m-1degree recall 71.3% to 42.3%.
evidence_type: external authors' empirical report; not reproduced here
inference_limits: Aggregate published results do not prove a pointwise causal mechanism. Standard uncertainty propagation, ray-height sensitivity and confidence weighting are not new; shared-reconstruction truth is not independent map-error truth.

            • Geometric constraints: Points distributed across the image plane, especially toward the
             borders, experience different projection behaviors than points clustered in the center. The
             peripheral points are more sensitive to focal length changes, providing stronger constraints
             during optimization.

Our AdHoP strategy specifically addresses this challenge by encouraging spatially diverse corre-
spondence distributions across the image plane. By ensuring correspondences span different image
regions with varying depths, we better constrain the parameter space and reduce the inherent focal
length-translation ambiguity, making the optimization more likely to converge to the correct parameter
values. This explains why our experimental results show significantly improved focal length and
translation estimates when using AdHoP, as the strategy effectively breaks the mathematical coupling
that would otherwise lead to ambiguous solutions.

inference_limits: The remaining 27.36% top-1 miss rate is observed at aggregate level; its cause is unknown. Do not invent a specific causal failure. Generic spatial weighting, clustering and multi-view consistency already exist in ONLoc.
